title: Hemp seeds and seed products

official_sources.title: Chapter 2.16 — Hemp seeds and seed products
Food Products Standards & Food Additives Compendium — current chapter index

regulatory_notes: Chapter 2.16 contains three named standardized product forms: hemp seed, hemp seed oil and hemp seed flour, plus cross-cutting limits for beverages and other foods containing hemp seed/seed products.

PMSV does not invent a FoSCoS food-category mapping for these three products. They are searchable as FSSAI chapter standards with FoSCoS mapping marked pending until an official current mapping is verified.
The chapter itself cross-references the NDPS Act/rules for cultivation. PMSV stores that FSSAI cross-reference but does not substitute an unofficial secondary source for the underlying law.

standards.name: Hemp seed
standards.definition: Hulled, non-viable seeds obtained from Cannabis sativa or other indigenous Cannabis species, subject to the Chapter 2.16 definition and cultivation cross-reference.

composition.parameter: Free fatty acid, expressed as oleic acid

standards.name: Hemp seed flour
standards.definition: Solid product after hemp seeds are milled to powder with or without extraction of oil.
standards.label_rule: Flour prepared after hemp seed has been pressed to extract oil shall clearly be labelled 'Deoiled hemp seed flour'.

cross_cutting_limits.scope: Any other food consisting of hemp seed or seed products
Any food consisting of hemp seed or seed products

restrictions.rule: Cannabinoids in food consisting of hemp seed or seed products shall only be present naturally in or on the seeds.
Food consisting of hemp seed or seed products shall not be labelled or otherwise presented in a way that expressly or by implication suggests a psychoactive effect.

The label shall not include a nutrient-content claim about cannabidiol, a health claim about cannabidiol, an image/representation of any part of the Cannabis plant other than the seed, or the words cannabis, marijuana or words of similar meaning.
The label may include the word 'Hemp'.
No food product containing hemp seed or seed products may be manufactured, imported or sold for administration to infants up to 24 months of age.

runtime_policy.final_compliance_lock: Do not issue full product compliance until current FoSCoS mapping, additives, contaminants, microbiology, processing aids and current label requirements are linked.
